description: Kartenlayer Straße, Nachtpegel LNight is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.nrw.de. Outside agglomerations, major roads (motorways, federal and state roads) with a traffic volume of more than 3 million motor vehicles per year must be mapped. In addition, other noise-relevant roads such as municipal roads or roads with lower traffic volumes are mapped in the agglomerations. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Map Layer Street, Night Level LNight" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Kartenlayer, LANUK-Kartenlayer, WMS, LANUK, Gebäude, opendata. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, GML. The listing shows 2025-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-zero-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
